checklist.empty.message: No critical issues found. Keep up the good compliance practices.
checklist.items.rem-privacy-policy.title: Publish a Privacy Policy
checklist.items.rem-privacy-policy.descr: Your app collects personal data but lacks a privacy policy. NDP Act Section 27 requires transparent information about data processing.
checklist.items.rem-consent.title: Implement Consent Mechanism
checklist.items.rem-consent.description: Obtain explicit, informed consent before collecting personal data as required by NDP Act Section 26.
checklist.items.rem-children.title: Child Data Protection
checklist.items.rem-children.description: Implement age verification and parental consent for users under 18 per NDP Act Section 31.
checklist.items.rem-appoint-dpo.title: Appoint Data Protection Officer
checklist.items.rem-appoint-dpo.descript: Designate a DPO as required for your processing activities under NDP Act Section 32.
checklist.items.rem-file-audit.title: File Compliance Audit Returns
checklist.items.rem-file-audit.descripti: Submit annual CAR filing to NDPC by March 31st as required by GAID 2025.
checklist.items.rem-register-ndpc.title: Register with NDPC
checklist.items.rem-register-ndpc.descri: Register as a data controller/processor of major importance under NDP Act Section 44.
checklist.items.rem-dpia.title: Conduct Data Protection Impact Assessment
checklist.items.rem-dpia.description: Perform DPIA for high-risk processing activities per NDP Act Section 28.
checklist.items.rem-cross-border.title: Cross-Border Transfer Safeguards
checklist.items.rem-cross-border.descrip: Ensure adequate protection for international data transfers per NDP Act Sections 41-43.
checklist.items.rem-third-party.title: Third-Party Data Processing Agreements
checklist.items.rem-third-party.descript: Execute written data processing agreements with all vendors and service providers.
checklist.items.rem-agf-coord.title: Attorney-General Federation Coordination
checklist.items.rem-agf-coord.descriptio: Coordinate cross-border transfer approvals with the AGF office as required.
checklist.items.rem-cookie-consent.title: Cookie Consent Implementation
checklist.items.rem-cookie-consent.descr: Implement cookie consent banner for website tracking and analytics.
footer.tagline: Bridging Nigerian innovation and regulation. AI-powered NDP Act & GAID 2025 compliance for the builders shaping Africa's future.
footer.whyBuilt.title: Why We Built This for Nigeria
footer.whyBuilt.description: Built in Abuja by Nigerian founders, for Nigerian regulations. We believe every Naija startup deserves to launch with confidence — knowing their data practices protect both their users and their business. RegTrack exists because compliance shouldn't be a barrier to innovation in Africa's largest tech ecosystem. Powered by the NDP Act 2023, NDPR Implementation Framework, and the GAID 2025.
